summary: Iteration 2 focuses on the new UP Ideias premium landing page (/) plus regression of login + backend health. All 12 landing scenarios from the review request passed end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL, and backend regression (health + login success + login wrong-password) passed via pytest. No fixes were required.

minor.issue: Pre-existing (iteration_1): brute-force lockout keyed on request.client.host (K8s ingress IP rotates) — not re-tested this iteration but noted for main agent.

issues: Dashboard KPI 'INVESTIMENTO (ADS) R$ 1.450,00' is static/demo but is not labeled as such (ROAS is now labeled '— DEMO'). Minor, from previous iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: Landing components are cleanly split into 8 files under /app/frontend/src/components/landing/*.tsx — good modularization, no file exceeds ~180 lines.
Framer Motion whileInView with `once: true` is used consistently; content becomes visible reliably on first scroll — verified.
Pricing.annual math (Math.round(1970/12) = 164) matches the spec — verified in UI.
All landing CTAs use next/link with proper data-testid attributes — excellent testability.

Hero headline is split into <motion.span> words; DOM concatenation drops inter-word spacing (e.g. 'Estratégia,conteúdoeconhecimento.' when read via textContent) — visually fine due to mr-[0.28em] but be aware for accessibility/screen readers; consider adding whitespace between spans or aria-label on <h1>.
seed_data_creation: None this iteration. Backend auto-seed unchanged from iteration 1.
